output.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.net_revenue), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND c.country = 'DE' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Net revenue in EUR from completed orders only (shipping fees excluded), for customers with country code DE, with order dates from 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31. The fiscal year equals the calendar year, so Q4 is October to December.
